method: Actual bundled MapLibre WorkerPool and public worker-count/prewarm APIs in isolated VM with real navigator UA/core metadata and inert Worker process doubles. No real threads, CPU speedup, memory amount or browser resource timing claimed.

checks.name: Actual shipped Chrome default is one worker even on an 18-logical-core environment
Actual shipped Safari default is separately capped at three workers
One pool shares the same worker objects across two map owners, and releases only after both leave
Changing getWorkerCount after acquire does not resize an already existing pool
Prewarming also fixes the pool size until every owner including prewarm is released
